Royle's early study of the age of Indian medicine and its relation to Greek medicine, with notes on the Āyurvedic physicians and their drugs (London, 1837).

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy of the Royal College of Surgeons of England; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: An essay on the antiquity of Hindoo medicine : including an introductory lecture to the course of materia medica and therapeutics, delivered at King's College · Royle, John Forbes, 1799-1858, Bunsen, Christian Karl Josias, Freiherr von, 1791-1860, former owner, Royal College of Surgeons of England · 1837, 210 scanned pages. Published 1837; John Forbes Royle died 1858; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
